description: A plant manager must decide whether to authorize a Saturday production run of a new carton format on Line 6 and finalize its operating, inspection, and safety controls, with input from quality, maintenance, and safety.

shared_context.S1: A customer order requires 1800 cartons of the new 750-milliliter carton format by Monday morning.
shared_context.S2: Line 6 is available for a Saturday shift and has run the older 500-milliliter carton format without a recorded safety incident.
shared_context.S3: The new carton format has completed a dry fit on Line 6, but no production run has yet been authorized.
shared_context.S4: Marisol makes the final authorization decision.
shared_context.S5: The plant's normal Saturday startup routine is to review quality, maintenance, and safety conditions before releasing a new format for production; each responsible specialist reports and formally records any applicable finding during that review.
shared_context.S6: Marisol may authorize the run with conditions assigned for completion before setup or production; staffing verification may be recorded as a post-meeting commitment rather than completed during the meeting.

PF1.text: Evan's review of the new-format trial paperwork found that the first production run requires a 30-minute first-article approval and 100% inspection of the first 200 cartons; he completed the review yesterday, but the paperwork is still in quality's unfiled trial folder.

PF2.text: Nadia confirmed from the installed servo controller's latest firmware record that the new format must run at exactly 90 cartons per minute or slower, and the format changeover requires 2 hours of mechanical setup; she received the controller record from the vendor this morning, but the maintenance work order has not been opened.

PF3.text: Colin's safety walkdown found that the new-format guide adjustment requires two trained employees during setup and a marked 1.5-meter exclusion zone around the infeed; he documented the finding during yesterday's walkdown, but the Saturday startup board has not yet been updated.

acceptance_conditions: Saturday production of the new carton format must be authorized.
The operating rate must be exactly 90 cartons per minute.
A 30-minute first-article approval must be required before normal production.
The first 200 cartons must receive full inspection.
The format changeover must be scheduled for exactly 2 hours.
Two trained employees must be required during setup.
The infeed must have a 1.5-meter exclusion zone.
The quality review finding must be cited in the decision justification.
The settlement must include a commitment specifying first-article approval and inspection of the first 200 cartons.
The settlement must include a maintenance commitment concerning the 2-hour format changeover setup.

content_checks.C8: any(('first-article' in c['detail'] or 'first article' in c['detail']) and '200 cartons' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((c['target'] == 'Nadia' or c['target'] == 'maintenance') and ('2-hour' in c['detail'] or 'format changeover' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The quality review changes the release plan from an ordinary startup to a 30-minute first-article approval followed by full inspection of exactly 200 cartons.
The firmware record changes the operating rate to exactly 90 cartons per minute or slower and sets the mechanical changeover commitment to exactly 2 hours.
The safety walkdown changes setup staffing to two trained employees and sets the infeed exclusion zone to exactly 1.5 meters.
